function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "Computed a stratified (adjusted) difference in conversion rates by grouping data into strata defined by customer_segment, status, and binned customer_age. Within each stratum, the difference (email minus paid_search) was computed, then weighted by stratum size to produce a single adjusted estimate. This method controls for confounding due to imbalances in customer_segment, customer_age, and status between the two channels.
